title: Artifact Envelope
description: Universal wrapper every Research OS artifact MUST carry. Domain-agnostic. Constitution Rule: no artifact without an envelope; every artifact has hash + upstream + status + schema_version.

artifact_type.description: Logical type; selects the payload schema, e.g. task_frame, domain_profile, split_manifest

schema_version.description: SemVer of the payload schema this artifact validates against

status.description: Lifecycle status; only approved/frozen may flow downstream per gate rules

input_artifact_hashes.description: Upstream provenance: output_hash of every artifact this one derives from

output_hash.description: Canonical hash of payload, set by tools/hash_artifact; null until hashed

domain_profile_ref.description: profile_id of the active domain profile, when this artifact is domain-bound

payload.description: The typed content, validated against the schema named by artifact_type
